item: Row 425: an interrupt while a window computed ahead is being taken kills that window instead of waiting for it
summary: reindex_articles emptied _ahead when a window's turn started, before reading its articles and waiting for its result, and the finally chose between waiting and killing on _ahead. A Ctrl-C or exception in that gap therefore WAITED for the window still computing in the kept pool (up to the pool timeout) before closing it. _pending_fut now names the ahead window until its result is taken, and the finally kills it whenever it is still pending. Found by the independent read of PR #2384; pinned by a test that interrupts window 2's own read and checks the pool is closed with abandon. Engine pins kept with --same.
